## POST `/api/2.29/software-bundle`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Creates and initiates a software bundle download. The upgrade won't start automatically after the download finishes. Only one software is being downloaded at a time. Any previous currently running download will be cancelled. The endpoint is not idempotent.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |

**Request body** (required): `SoftwareBundlePost`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `source` | string | The source of the software bundle. Accepts HTTP, HTTPS, FTP or SFTP and paths. |

**Responses:** `200` The software bundle has started downloading successfully. → `SoftwareBundleResponse`

## POST `/api/2.29/software-check`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Creates a software check task. To create a task, use a software name and version. If a task is already running, an error is returned.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |
| `software_names` | query | array of string |  | A comma-separated list of software names. |
| `software_versions` | query | array of string |  | A comma-separated list of target software versions. |

**Responses:** `200` The software check record was created successfully. → `SoftwareChecksResponse` · `403` Another instance is already running
